name: 36832 · Auburn, AL
findings: ZIP 36832 (Auburn) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36832 (Auburn) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 36832 (Auburn) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).
